title: Sand + Sky | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Featured in Coastal Lifestyle Magazine - New Home Adjacent to Luxury Resort Pool - Gated - Gulf Views - Short Stroll Beach Access - 3 Stories of Opulence - All En Suite Accommodations - Incredible Finishes Throughout
description_expanded: Description: Sand & Sky by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach - Gated SeaNest Village on 30A Address: 238 Sand Oaks Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Discover a harmonious blend of coastal relaxation and upscale convenience at Sand & Sky in Seagrove Beach. Nestled in the sought-after, gated community of SeaNest, this location along 30A offers white sands, emerald waters, walkable villages, and the soothing rhythm of the Gulf—an ideal setting for an elevated lifestyle. This impressive 4,000-square-foot residence boasts five bedrooms and five-and-a-half bathrooms across three levels, showcasing custom finishes throughout. Additional porches and a sun deck enhance the living experience, while meticulously designed floors provide a perfect mix of gathering spaces and private retreats. The second level serves as the heart of the home, featuring a stunning curved wood-paneled wall and foyer that highlight the interior's sculptural elegance. The open-concept living room, dining area, and kitchen invite both tranquil moments and lively gatherings. The kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, a wine cooler, and a glass wine display, combining artistic flair with functionality. A walk-in pantry and striking island further elevate daily living with understated elegance. In the living room, a Net Zero Peninsula fireplace creates a safe, touchable flame through mist and LED light, serving as a modern focal point that embodies comfort and innovation. This level also includes a junior suite with a remarkable glass tub, a powder room, and a laundry area. A rear porch, complete with an outdoor summer kitchen, encourages seamless transitions from indoor to outdoor gatherings. On the third floor, a sitting area with a wet bar opens up to a sun terrace boasting stunning Gulf views. The outdoor living space, framed by elegant stone flooring, offers a retreat featuring a sleek fire table and seating. The main suite serves as an owner's sanctuary, complete with a spa-like bath and a spacious walk-in closet. An additional guest suite ensures comfort and privacy for every visitor. Delightful and unexpected details await discovery throughout the home. Be among the first to experience Sand & Sky, where modern refinement beautifully merges with coastal elegance. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 14 5 Bedrooms | 5 Full Baths | 1 Half Bath | 1 Outdoor Shower First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath - Bedroom 2: Two Twin over Full Bunk Beds with Private Bath - Living/Family Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Vessel Tub and Sower) -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area / Open Concept Floor Plan / Outdoor Grilling and Balcony / View of Resort Pool Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: King Bed, Private Bath (Vessel Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 5: King Bed Private Bath (Shower) - Living Space, Balcony, Firepit, Gulf Views, View of Resort Pool Amenities Include: - 6 Adult Bikes - 7 Minute Walk to Beach (2nd Beach Access Almost Complete) - Beach Towel Service - Infinity Resort Style Pool Adjacent to Home - Gated Community - Near Greenway Shops and Dining and Old Florida Dining, Shops and Entertainment - Bike or Walk to Multiple Seagrove Highlights Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
